text:
alex: heads up — canary 23.3 rolled to 30% in us-west, deploy-bot just flagged error_rate spike on /v1/generate (alerts >3%). wondering if we pin traffic or roll back.
deploy-bot: Canary alert: service=api, route=/v1/generate, error_rate=3.7%, p95_latency=1.9s, window=2m. auto-rollback conditions not met (needs 5m).
jordan: pulling metrics now, give me 60s. Warming KVCACHE might explain p95 bump.
maya: any customer-facing errors? Support says 2 reports from non-critical customers, 1 timed out request.
samir: if this sustains for 5m above 2% we should auto-rollback. otherwise temp pin to previous stable version (23.2) and throttle traffic.
lina: agree on pin + comms. I'll draft a short postmortem template + release-note blurb in #product after we decide.
ajex: typo, that's alex :) — ok, i'm +1 for pin to 23.2 and reduce canary to 10% while we investigate. Can someone run the pin? :thumbsup:
jordan: I can pin and start a 10% traffic throttle. executing in 10s.
jordan: exec log: 
```
# reduce canary weight and pin
redwood deploy traffic-set --service api --canary 10 --pin-version 23.2
kubectl -n redwood rollout undo deployment/api-deployment --to-revision=2302
```
samir: thanks. let's set the rollback criteria and owners:
- automatic rollback if error_rate > 2% for 5 consecutive minutes OR p95 > 3s for 5m
- manual rollback allowed by release lead or oncall
- comms owner: lina (customer note + internal postmortem)
- exec owner: jordan (pin/rollback ops)

lina: drafting comms now. short note to support: "We observed a canary error-rate increase on /v1/generate; we've pinned traffic to previous stable and reduced canary exposure while we investigate. No broad customer impact detected. We'll follow up with root cause and ETA."

alex: @sre-bot can you create an incident ticket with tags: canary, rollback-consideration, us-west?
sre-bot: Incident created: INC-2026-1196, priority=P2, assignees=@jordan,@samir, link: https://incidents.redwood.internal/INC-2026-1196

jordan: pin applied, canary now at 10%, version 23.2 pinned. monitoring window 5m.
maya: visible drop in errors after pin — good sign. continue investigation on KV cache warmup and model kernel change in 23.3.

samir: if we don't see reversion in 10m, mark for rollback to 23.2 across regions. also capture failing request logs for triage.

alex: quick checklist for follow-up: 1) generate hotfix candidate if root cause is model runtime change; 2) schedule brief postmortem; 3) update release notes and call out mitigations; 4) coordinate customer comms if we see regressions.
lina: noted. I'll post the comms draft and send to support for approval.

deply-bot: (note: typo) — deploy-bot: will post deployment audit once rollback window closes.

alex: thanks team. keep updates concise here. if we go full rollback i'll ping sales + CS for heads up. :eyes:
